text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever I read the letters I receive,
I can't help but find it so wondrous.

As she reads through the fan letters,
North Flight begins to speak in a soft, gentle voice.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing was going right for me,
and I was feeling down every day. That was when
I happened to watch your race."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Flight-san, you looked truly radiant.
Even though you and I are different, seeing you made me think that maybe I could shine like that too—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"‘Your running
gave me that kind of hope.’"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't reached my ideal self just yet.
However..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing that there are people
who watch over me like this—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes... Though, of course, the happiness I feel far outweighs any of that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
But...
just like how I looked up to my big sister,
there are people who look up to me now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's so strange... and a little embarrassing.
...It makes me feel kind of ticklish.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“...I wonder if there's anything
I can do to help...”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just like Big Sis,
I thought... maybe I could convey something to this person too.

Uncharacteristically, North Flight
seems restless and fidgety.
choice_data_list: I think the message has already gotten across.

text_block_list.text:
"You gave me hope."
—Those words must be the answer.
choice_data_list: You conveyed it through your running.
You conveyed it through your running.

text_block_list.text: A hope that perhaps I, too, could shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I have to...
I have to work much harder than I am right now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So that I can show this person
the radiance I've always wished for.
